title: Cartwise+ Membership Re-Verification Offer on Proof-Based Plans
content:
A re-verification offer is given to Cartwise+ Membership members on a plan that requires eligibility proof when they move up from a monthly plan to Cartwise+ Annual.

**Rule.** On a plan that requires eligibility proof: when at least 11 whole months have passed since the proof was last accepted, the offer is 2.00; when fewer have passed, it is 1.00. On a plan that requires no proof, the offer is 0.00.

| Plan held | Requires eligibility proof | Whole months since the proof was last accepted | Offer taken off (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | yes (SNAP EBT card, re-accepted every 12 months) | 11 or more | 2.00 |
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | yes | fewer than 11 | 1.00 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | yes (student email address, re-accepted every 12 months) | 11 or more | 2.00 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | yes | fewer than 11 | 1.00 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | no | any | 0.00 |

## Evidence

The date the proof was last accepted, as the membership record shows it, counted in whole months up to today; a month is whole on the same day of the month as that date.

## Hypothetical boundary cases (Cartwise+ Student Monthly, today 20 April)

| Proof last accepted | Whole months since | Offer |
|---|---|---|
| 20 May of the previous year | 11 | 2.00 |
| 21 May of the previous year | 10 | 1.00 |
